Service Requirements The Contractor must provide printing services, including the following tasks: • Graphic design and creation of annual report content for various Embassy offices. • Graphic design and creation of brochures, information portfolios, folders, advertising publications, flyers, and similar materials for the Embassy's promotional events. • Printing and/or photocopying of documents, brochures, and portfolios in a professional manner, ensuring clear colors, photographs, text, and images for finished products. Preference will be given to contractors offering multiple printing methods, such as commercial, digital, press, and web-based printing. • Supplying stock images for publications, as needed. • Providing printing designs for requesting offices to review and confirm prior to production. The Contractor is responsible for installing, setting up, and delivering printed items to U.S. Embassy Hanoi events. • Material Requirements: The Contractor shall present several material options for the Embassy's selection prior to submitting a quote. The Contractor shall deliver fully operational, integrated, and sustained EW SITE systems and sub-system components for domestic and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The required outcome is an EW SITE system capable of supporting a multitude of laboratory-specific System Configurations across multiple platforms (EA-18G, F/A-18, MH-60) while maintaining configuration consistency with the Advanced Weapons Laboratory (AWL) at NAWCWD China Lake, CA. Additionally, the Contractor shall ensure continuous operational readiness of current EW SITE systems through comprehensive lifecycle support, including on-call and on-site maintenance, system upgrades, replacement parts provisioning, and personnel training. This Contract will have FFP CLINs. The Contract will have a five-year period of performance. A properly executed QASP will assist the Government in achieving the objectives of this procurement. 2. Purpose This Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) is a Government developed and applied document used to ensure the systematic Quality Assurance (QA) methods are used in the administration surveillance of tasking under the Contract. The required outcome is an EW SITE system capable of supporting a multitude of laboratory-specific System Configurations across multiple platforms (EA-18G, F/A-18, MH-60) while maintaining configuration consistency with the Advanced Weapons Laboratory (AWL) at NAWCWD China Lake, CA. Additionally, the Contractor shall ensure continuous operational readiness of current EW SITE systems through comprehensive lifecycle support, including on-call and on-site maintenance, system upgrades, replacement parts provisioning, and personnel training. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. deliverables_scope.text: ..................... ................................ ........ 6 6 Kreditering ................................ ................................ ................................ ..... 6 1 Krav om elektronisk fakturering I medhold av Forskrift om elektronisk faktura i offentlige anskaffelser (2.april 2019) er EHF faktura obligatorisk ved fakturering til kommunene. All fakturering til Harstad kommune og samarbeidskommuner som inngår i kontrakten, må gjennomføres i Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF). Godkjente standardformater er EHF fakturering versjon 3.0 eller nyere og PEPPOL BIS (PEPPOL Business Interoperability Specification) Billing v3.0 eller nyere. Dette dokumentet omfatter bestemmelser om hvordan elektronisk fakturering gjennomføres for Harstad kommune med samarbeidskommuner, i EHF-formatet. Dokumentet beskriver kun de spesifikke informasjonselementene kommunene sender og har behov for å motta fra leverandøren. Obligatorisk innhold i EHF3.0 omhandles ikke i denne spesifikasjonen, slik som virksomhetsadresser, mva. håndtering, kontoopplysninger og lignende. For en mer omfattende veiledning for Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF) v3.0, se: Elektronisk Handelsformat - EHF - Prosessdefinisjoner | Anskaffelser.no Spesifikasjon av felter og innhold er i
